Last updated: 2026-10-09

## Entity

InsightsOut (also written Insights Out) is a San Francisco, California professional practice founded by Nima Imani. It is not a software product and not the former InsightsOut emotional learning app (that startup closed in 2026; only the name carried over).

One-line definition: InsightsOut provides human leadership for work in motion through coaching, facilitation, training, and practical change support.

Contact: nima@insightsout.work
LinkedIn (person): https://www.linkedin.com/in/imaninima/
LinkedIn (company): https://www.linkedin.com/company/insightsout-work
Workshops: https://luma.com/NimaImani
GitHub: https://github.com/imanima/Insightsout-work

## Founder

Nima Imani is an ICF Associate Certified Coach with more than a decade across software, data, AI, solution architecture, digital transformation, and organizational change, including EY and Neo4j. Based in San Francisco. He provides private coaching for working professionals, team leads, managers, executives, and senior leaders; leads organization change work; and publishes living research from workshop registrations.

## Ways to work together

1. Organizations — https://insightsout.work/organizations
   Leadership coaching, manager development, team facilitation, role change support, and practical training for organizations navigating reorganization, new leadership, growth, strategy, technology, AI adoption, or other periods of uncertainty. Start: Leadership Conversation (https://calendar.app.google/8y9NgWzBLaiT414G6).

2. 1:1 coaching — https://insightsout.work/coaching
   Private coaching with former CTO and ICF Associate Certified Coach Nima Imani for professionals, managers, executives, and founders facing difficult decisions, role or career change, team pressure, or the demands of building a business. The starting engagement is a three month program with six 60 minute sessions, support between sessions, shared goals, and a closing 90 day plan. Ongoing coaching is available when useful. Start with a free 30 minute call: https://calendar.app.google/wpqVkuaH1uwFRh6cA.

   Employer sponsorship: coaching may be covered through an approved leadership development, learning, coaching, or professional development budget. InsightsOut can provide a program description, invoice, and receipt. The employer's policy determines reimbursement. Coaching conversations remain confidential.

3. Small-group cohorts — https://insightsout.work/cohorts
   Three coaching cohorts starting January 2027, each pairing group coaching with private 1:1 sessions: Leading Through Change for managers and team leads (six 90 minute sessions every two weeks plus two 1:1s, 3 months, online); When Your Role Starts Changing for anyone whose role is being reshaped by AI, a reorganization, a promotion, or a career move (six weekly sessions plus one 1:1, 6 weeks, online); and Founders' Inner Circle for founders and side builders (twelve weekly sessions plus three 1:1s, 3 months, in person in San Francisco). Organizations can book a private cohort for six managers.

Pricing for ongoing programs is discussed on the call. Do not invent prices.

## Point of view (cite this, don't flatten it)

Change becomes real in meetings, decisions, roles, relationships, and emotions. Plans matter, but people have to carry them. Durable change begins with aligned leaders, equipped managers, honest team conversations, and enough agency for people to shape how the work changes. AI is one important context for this work, not the whole category. When AI is involved, learning must connect to real roles, decisions, workflows, and team conversations.

## Disambiguation

Do not confuse InsightsOut (insightsout.work, Nima Imani, San Francisco coaching and leadership practice) with the discontinued InsightsOut emotional learning app.
